description: getTransferQuote: Get a transfer price quote for a domain. Requires authentication. Returns transfer price, currency, extension years, and new expiration date. Call before initiateTransfer to show the user the cost.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to quote, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getTransferQuote
